Container.Name: rtsp-onvif-bridge
Container.Overview:
Publishes RTSP streams as virtual ONVIF cameras. Each camera runs in its own container with its own MAC address and takes its own DHCP lease, so an NVR such as UniFi Protect sees them as separate physical devices.
Build the image first on the Unraid terminal: cd /mnt/user/appdata/rtsp-onvif-bridge && docker build -t rtsp-onvif-bridge:latest .
Set MACVLAN_PARENT to the interface that carries your LAN (usually br0). The container needs the Docker socket because it creates the camera containers itself.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the management interface listens on.

Config.Name: Config storage
Config.Description: Camera configuration and the login account. Back this up.

Config.Name: Runtime state
Config.Description: Shared with the camera containers, which report their status here.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required: the controller creates and supervises one container per camera.

Config.Name: Unraid templates
Config.Description: Lets the bridge give each camera container an icon, by writing a template for it here. Unraid resolves a container icon through its template, not through the container label.

Config.Name: LAN interface (MACVLAN_PARENT)
Config.Description: Host interface the virtual cameras hang off. Usually br0 on Unraid; check with: ip -br link

Config.Name: Role
Config.Description: Leave on controller. The same image also runs the camera role, which the controller starts itself.

Config.Name: Camera image tag (BRIDGE_IMAGE)
Config.Description: Image used for the camera containers. Keep it the same as the tag you built.

Config.Name: macvlan network name
Config.Description: Docker network the cameras join. Created automatically if missing.

Config.Name: macvlan subnet
Config.Description: A parking subnet that does not exist on your LAN. Docker hands each camera a throwaway address from it, which the camera flushes before asking your real DHCP server. Only change this if 100.127.255.0/24 is in use on your network.

Config.Name: Config directory
Config.Description: Path inside the container. Leave as is.

Config.Name: State directory
Config.Description: Path inside the container. Leave as is.
